title: Redirect site root to browser locale

spec.problem: kiokoto.com root (/) returns Next.js 404 because apps/web has no root page or proxy; users typing the bare domain land on a not-found page.

acceptance.text: GET / with a supported Accept-Language (ja, en, vi) redirects with 307 to the matching /<locale>.
GET / without a supported language (none, or only unsupported such as fr) redirects to /vi.
Quality values rank languages; q=0 and malformed q are ignored; query string is preserved; response carries Vary: Accept-Language.

spec.expected_behavior: GET / redirects (307) to /vi, /ja or /en chosen from the browser Accept-Language header, default vi; query string preserved; Vary: Accept-Language set.
spec.rollback_plan: Delete apps/web/proxy.ts; the site returns to the previous 404 on /.

classification.rationale: Root HTTP redirect behaviour plus a pure locale negotiation helper; no auth, data or infrastructure change.

red_exception.reason: New module apps/web/lib/locale-negotiation.ts; its test cannot import it at the base commit.

targets.test: negotiateLocale > picks a supported language from the browser preference order
negotiateLocale > honours quality values over list order
proxy > redirects with 307 to the browser locale and keeps the query string
